LESSON: GUIDED READING: PICTURE READING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.3 Guided reading: Fluency (2 sessions) By the end of the Sub Strand, t
Topic 2.5: Guided Reading: Picture Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading: Picture Reading, part of Reading 2.3 Guided reading: Fluency (2 sessions) By the end of the Sub Strand, t in Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we celebrate special occasions? 2. How are pictures regarded to be worth a thousand words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly with peers to study pictures on family celebrations and describe the events,

2. pick out people and things from the picture,

3. collect pictures of things found during family celebrations and organise in a class portfolio,

4. team up to answer questions on pictures related to family celebrations and make predictions,

5. collaborate with peers to prepare a picture book on family celebrations for extensive reading of Arabic texts for enjoyment. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly with peers to study pictures on family celebrations and describe the events,
2. pick out people and things from the picture,
3. collect pictures of things found during family celebrations and organise in a class portfolio,
4. team up to answer questions on pictures related to family celebrations and make predictions,
5. collaborate with peers to prepare a picture book on family celebrations for extensive reading of Arabic texts for enjoyment. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading: Picture Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: This is promoted as the learner engages in collective learning by collaborating with peers to collaborate with

peers to prepare a picture book on family celebrations for extensive reading of Arabic texts for enjoyment.

Values:
Unity: This is enhanced as the learner works jointly with peers to collect pictures of things found during family celebrations

and organise in a class portfolio.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: This is promoted as the learner interacts with texts on family celebrations that bring people together for

coexistence.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to link the concept of picture reading to their learning of visual representations of ideas in Creative Arts.
